cap: Each pitfall follows from what the agent does. Estrogen keeps FSH low and raises liver clotting factors, so it brings venous thromboembolism, and stroke when migraine aura or smoking at 35 or older already raises the risk. Suppressing ovulation lowers ovarian cancer risk. DMPA lowers estradiol and bone density, copper raises prostaglandins and bleeding, enzyme inducers cause pill failure, and obesity weakens levonorgestrel emergency contraception.
